title: Superb
body: A great and simple app that enables you to customize the way you track and build habbits. Love the visuals! I’d love it even more if it was compatible with my iwatch and allowed to mark done with it.
author: marrrinche

title: Not free
body: Misleading to say it’s a free app since you can add only 3 habits for free and to add more you have to pay annual subscription. Otherwise good and simple app.
author: naanaanana
